body: Implement handleContact({req,deps}) with the ordered gates honeypot -> same-origin allowlist -> rate limit -> BotID -> sink, returning the shared envelope {ok:true}|{ok:false,error,fields?} per PM-G. Rate limiter keys on x-forwarded-for first hop and evicts expired windows (PM-B). BotID isBot=true -> 403; checkBot throwing fails open through remaining gates (PM-C/AC13). No PII or secret in logs/response (PM-D/AC8). Thin app/api/contact/route.ts wires real checkBotId + selectSink. Verification: cd apps/docs && node --test test/contact-route.test.mjs. Satisfies AC5-AC8, AC13-AC15. allow-suppression: none

edges.contract: T-CC1 exports parseLead + selectSink + SinkError; T-CC2 consumes them in handleContact.

title: Contact capture: POST /api/contact route (handleContact core + Vercel BotID wrapper)
